WITH CUST_TOT_REL 
AS
(
	SELECT 
		 EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,EDA.BANK_ID BANK_ID
		,ECD.ORGKEY CIF
		,CS.L1_SEGMENT_ID CUST_SEGMENT_ID
		,NULL TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
		--,SUM(TRB_DEPOSITS + TRB_INVEST + TRB_BANCA) TRB
		,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP TRB_DEPOSITS
		--,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY,0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST,0))	TRB_INVEST
		,NULL	TRB_TREASURY
		,NULL	TRB_TRUST
		,NULL	TRB_BANCA
		,NULL	TRB_SECURITIES
		--,SUM(COALESCE(TRE_LOANS,0) + COALESCE(TRE_CARDS,0)) TRE
		,NULL	TRE_LOANS
		,NULL	TRE_CARDS

	FROM 
		EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA --- round_robin
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF --- gam_acid
		ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD --- orgkey
		ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT CS
		ON CS.CIF = ECD.ORGKEY
		AND CS.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	WHERE
		EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN  ('M', 'J')
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE,2)  <> '09'
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'  
		AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2024-10-08' AS DATE)
)

INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL
(
     AS_OF_DATE         
    ,BANK_ID            
    ,CIF                
    ,CUST_SEGMENT_ID    
    ,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP 
    ,TRB                
    ,TRB_DEPOSITS       
    ,TRB_INVEST         
    ,TRB_TRUST          
    ,TRB_TREASURY       
    ,TRB_BANCA          
    ,TRB_SECURITIES     
    ,TRE		           
    ,TRE_LOANS          
    ,TRE_CARDS          
)

SELECT 
	 AS_OF_DATE
	,BANK_ID
	,CIF
	,CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP
	,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS,0) + COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY,0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST,0) + COALESCE(TRB_BANCA,0)) TRB
	,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_DEPOSITS,0)) TRB_DEPOSITS
	,SUM(COALESCE(TRB_TREASURY,0) + COALESCE(TRB_TRUST,0))	TRB_INVEST
	,TRB_TRUST
	,TRB_TREASURY
	,TRB_BANCA
	,TRB_SECURITIES
	,SUM(COALESCE(TRE_LOANS,0) + COALESCE(TRE_CARDS,0)) TRE
	,TRE_LOANS
	,TRE_CARDS
FROM CUST_TOT_REL
GROUP BY 
	 AS_OF_DATE
	,BANK_ID
	,CIF
	,CUST_SEGMENT_ID
	,TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP	
	,TRB_TREASURY
	,TRB_TRUST
	,TRB_BANCA
	,TRB_SECURITIES
	,TRE_LOANS
	,TRE_CARDS
